**Overview**

This dashboard provides visibility into user synchronization activity collected from PingDirectory.

It highlights user sync trends and employment type distribution across the environment. The dashboard helps administrators and analysts monitor user provisioning activity, identify changes in the user directory, and understand the composition of synced users.

Visualizations include user sync events over time, users by employment type, users by title, and a user account inventory table. Interactive filters allow scoping the view to relevant synced user records for focused analysis and troubleshooting.
